children: Michael Olosky, a director and the President, CEO of Simpson, reported a sale of common stock on September 10, 2026. The filing states the shares were sold at a weighted average price of $172.84 per share. The total sale amount reported was $605,285 for 3,502 shares disposed of. After the transaction, Olosky directly owned 51,398 shares of common stock, which includes unvested restricted stock units and shares deferred under the company’s nonqualified plan, and reflects an additional four shares not previously reported.
